heading.en: From a heap to neat shelves

hook.en: A library with 10,000 books piled on the floor is useless. Books are sorted by subject, author and year. Data need the same treatment.
hook.kn: ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ರಾಶಿ ಹಾಕಿದ 10,000 ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳ ಗ್ರಂಥಾಲಯ ಉಪಯೋಗವಿಲ್ಲ. ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳನ್ನು ವಿಷಯ, ಲೇಖಕ, ವರ್ಷದಂತೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ದತ್ತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ.

objectives.en: Explain raw data and the need for classification
Name the four types of classification

narration.en: A library with 10,000 books piled on the floor is useless. Books are sorted by subject, author and year. Data need the same treatment.
narration.kn: ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ರಾಶಿ ಹಾಕಿದ 10,000 ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳ ಗ್ರಂಥಾಲಯ ಉಪಯೋಗವಿಲ್ಲ. ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳನ್ನು ವಿಷಯ, ಲೇಖಕ, ವರ್ಷದಂತೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ದತ್ತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ.

title.en: Raw data and why we classify

body.en: Data collected in their original, unorganised form are called raw data. Classification is the process of arranging raw data into groups or classes according to common characteristics. It makes data concise, easy to compare and ready for analysis.
body.kn: ಮೂಲ ರೂಪದ ಅಸಂಘಟಿತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವೇ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ. ಸಮಾನ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಗುಂಪುಗಳಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುವುದು ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ.

narration.en: Data collected in their original, unorganised form are called raw data. Classification is the process of arranging raw data into groups or classes according to common characteristics. It makes data concise, easy to compare and ready for analysis.
narration.kn: ಮೂಲ ರೂಪದ ಅಸಂಘಟಿತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವೇ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ. ಸಮಾನ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಗುಂಪುಗಳಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುವುದು ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ.

body.en: Chronological classification groups data by time (years, months). Spatial classification groups data by place (states, districts). Qualitative classification groups by attributes such as gender or literacy. Quantitative classification groups by measurable characteristics such as marks, income or height.
body.kn: ಕಾಲಾನುಕ್ರಮ (ಸಮಯದ ಆಧಾರ), ಪ್ರಾದೇಶಿಕ (ಸ್ಥಳದ ಆಧಾರ), ಗುಣಾತ್ಮಕ (ಗುಣಗಳ ಆಧಾರ) ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಮಾಣಾತ್ಮಕ (ಅಳತೆಯ ಆಧಾರ) ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ.

narration.en: Chronological classification groups data by time (years, months). Spatial classification groups data by place (states, districts). problem.en: Name the type of classification: (a) rice output of Karnataka, Punjab and West Bengal; (b) India's exports in 2020, 2021, 2022; (c) employees by marital status; (d) workers grouped by daily wage ₹300–400, ₹400–500.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Name the type of classification: (a) rice output of Karnataka, Punjab and West Bengal; (b) India's exports in 2020, 2021, 2022; (c) employees by marital status; (d) workers grouped by daily wage ₹300–400, ₹400–500.

body.en: Ask "By what are we grouping?" Time → chronological, Place → spatial, Attribute → qualitative, Measure → quantitative.

narration.en: T-P-A-M: Time, Place, Attribute, Measure. Ask "By what are we grouping?" Time → chronological, Place → spatial, Attribute → qualitative, Measure → quantitative.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two exam-pattern questions of the kind asked in the PUC board, CBSE board and CUET.

points.en: Raw data are unorganised figures as collected.
points.kn: ಕಚ್ಚಾ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ ರೂಪದ ಅಸಂಘಟಿತ ಅಂಕಿಗಳು.

points.en: Classification arranges data into groups with common features.
Data can be classified by time, place, attribute or measured value.
points.kn: ಸಮಯ, ಸ್ಥಳ, ಗುಣ ಅಥವಾ ಅಳತೆಯ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಬಹುದು.

homework.en: Give one example of each kind of classification using data about your district.

narration.en: Recap. Raw data are unorganised figures as collected. Classification arranges data into groups with common features. Data can be classified by time, place, attribute or measured value.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಚ್ಚಾ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ ರೂಪದ ಅಸಂಘಟಿತ ಅಂಕಿಗಳು. ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ ಸಮಾನ ಲಕ್ಷಣದ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮಯ, ಸ್ಥಳ, ಗುಣ ಅಥವಾ ಅಳತೆಯ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಬಹುದು.
